info.title: ROF LMS API
info.description:
Rwanda Olympiad Foundation Learning Management System — Mathematics.

Authenticate with POST /api/v1/auth/login, then send `Authorization: Bearer <access_token>`.
Errors always have the shape `{ statusCode, error, code, message, details?, requestId }`.

Every operation states who may call it (`x-roles`). Beyond the role, records are scoped: students see their own work and their division's published content; mentors their assigned course × division scopes and the submissions assigned to them.

mode.description: OPEN (open now, until closesAt if set), CLOSED, or SCHEDULED (open from opensAt until closesAt).

opensAt.description: When a SCHEDULED form opens (required for SCHEDULED). null removes it.

closesAt.description: When the form closes (OPEN or SCHEDULED); null = no closing date. Must be after opensAt.

requireEmailVerification.description:
Sign-up forms only (STUDENT_REGISTRATION, TEACHER_REGISTRATION, COACH_APPLICATION; 400 NOT_A_SIGN_UP_FORM
otherwise): true — people who sign up with this form must confirm their e-mail (activation link) before they can
sign in; false (the default) — no activation. Applies to accounts created from then on.

closedMessage.description: Shown while the form is closed (and returned with a refused submission).

instructions.description: Extra guidance shown with the form (open or closed).

phonePrefix.description: International calling code, e.g. "+254"; null removes it.

code.description: Permanent code: 2–30 capitals, digits or underscores, starting with a letter; never ALL.

isActive.description: false: offered for no new student, test or course (refused while students are in it or a test is open).

suggestedGrades.description: The grades this division is suggested for (every grade S1–S6 must stay with exactly one active division).

field.description: A field key from GET /admin/registration-data/fields, e.g. "user.lastName".

teacherId.description: assignTeacher, unassignTeacher, grantDelegation, revokeDelegation: the Teacher.

toTeacherId.description: reassignTeacher: the Teacher the students move to.

olympiadLevel.description: setOlympiadLevel: JUNIOR, MIDDLE, SENIOR, or AUTOMATIC (the level the grade suggests).

selectionToken.description: From the preview: binds this request to exactly the previewed accounts.

expectedTotal.description: The total the administrator confirmed (secondary check).

confirm.description: Must be true: the administrator confirmed the action.

idempotencyKey.description: The same key returns the same operation; nothing is done twice.

reason.description: Required (3–500 characters) for deactivate, suspend, archive and restore.

currentPassword.description: Required when the action touches Administrator or Super Administrator accounts or roles (checked, never stored).

gradeLevel.description: Required for students; determines the division.

schoolCode.description:
A Rwandan school by its official code — an alternative to schoolId (PR B). Given together,
both must name the same school.

username.description: Optional; generated from the e-mail address when omitted.

gradeLevel.description: Required for students (S1–S6); determines the division.

schoolId.description:
The student's school: an EXISTING school, by id and/or official code (PR B). Invitations and
CSV imports never create a school — an Administrator creates it first (POST /admin/schools).

schoolCode.description: A Rwandan school's 6-digit official code (alternative to schoolId; both must name the same school).

schoolName.description:
Optional check only: when given with schoolCode / schoolId it must be that school's name
(case, accents and punctuation ignored), otherwise the invitation or row is refused
(SCHOOL_NAME_MISMATCH). Alone it is refused (SCHOOL_REFERENCE_REQUIRED) — it never creates
or matches a school.

schoolLocation.description: Accepted for compatibility with earlier clients and CSV files; not used (the school's own location applies).

currentPassword.description:
Your own current password (step-up, P1-08). Required to change a role to or
from ADMIN or SUPER_ADMIN; otherwise ignored. Never stored or logged.

gradeLevel.description: Changing the grade moves a student to the matching division.

schoolId.description:
Omitted: the school is kept. A school id: the student moves to that school. null: the
student's school is cleared (their current school claim ends; no new claim is created).

schoolCode.description:
A Rwandan school by its official code — an alternative to schoolId (PR B). Given together,
both must name the same school.

homeCountry.description:
Home location (homeLocationRules; owner, 2026-11-20): the home country (ISO 3166-1 alpha-2, stored in `country`);
with Rwanda the home province, district and sector are required (a place of the official directory, else 400
UNKNOWN_HOME_LOCATION); with another country they are not asked and the stored ones are cleared (sent anyway:
400 HOME_LOCATION_RWANDA_ONLY). The place is only accepted together with homeCountry (400 HOME_COUNTRY_REQUIRED).
Separate from the school location.

gender.description: Correct the account's gender (FEMALE or MALE; capability genderStep). Not audited with its value.

olympiadInterests.description:
A Coach's Olympiad subject interests (capability coachOlympiadInterests), replacing the stored ones: one or more of
MATHEMATICS, COMPUTING and PHYSICS, no duplicates. Coach (MENTOR) accounts only (400 INTERESTS_COACH_ONLY); the
route already needs users.manage and the right to manage the account's role (users.manageCoaches). Information only:
interests never grant marking or any other permission.

olympiadInterestOther.description:
Another Olympiad named in words ("Other"; owner 2026-11-21; capability olympiadInterestOther), 2–100 characters,
e.g. "Chemistry". With it, olympiadInterests may be empty. null clears it (only beside at least one subject).
Never a subject: grants nothing, not part of Test Management.

isApproved.description: Approve a student or mentor waiting for approval.

reason.description: Required (3–500 characters) to deactivate, suspend or archive, and to restore an archived account.

confirm.description: Must be true to restore an archived account (ARCHIVED → ACTIVE); ignored otherwise.

homeCountry.description:
Home location (homeLocationRules; owner, 2026-11-20): the home country (ISO 3166-1 alpha-2, stored in `country`);
with Rwanda the home province, district and sector are required (a place of the official directory, else 400
UNKNOWN_HOME_LOCATION); with another country they are not asked and the stored ones are cleared (sent anyway:
400 HOME_LOCATION_RWANDA_ONLY). The place is only accepted together with homeCountry (400 HOME_COUNTRY_REQUIRED).
Separate from the school location.

olympiadInterests.description:
The caller's Olympiad interests (owner decision 8), replacing the stored ones: one or more of
MATHEMATICS, COMPUTING and PHYSICS, no duplicates (capability studentOlympiadInterests).

olympiadInterestOther.description:
Another Olympiad named in words ("Other"; owner 2026-11-21; capability olympiadInterestOther), 2–100 characters,
e.g. "Chemistry". With it, olympiadInterests may be empty. null clears it (only beside at least one subject).
Never a subject: grants nothing, not part of Test Management.

divisionId.description: An active division. Required unless `automatic` is true; refused with it (400 LEVEL_WITH_AUTOMATIC).

automatic.description: true: follow the grade again (the suggested division).

reason.description: Why (3–500 characters): kept in the student's level history.

gradeLevel.description: S1–S3 places the student in the Junior division, S4–S6 in Senior.

country.description:
Country of the school (ISO 3166-1 alpha-2). Default RW (Rwanda). Rwanda: the school
comes from the official directory (schoolCode). Any other country: the school name
is recorded as entered, unverified — never matched to a Rwandan school.

schoolCode.description:
Rwanda: official code of the school attended (6 digits, from GET /schools/search or
the Province → District → Sector listing). The student is linked to exactly that
school. Required unless schoolId or schoolName is sent.

schoolId.description:
Rwanda (owner decision 2026-11-14): the internal id of the school attended, from
GET /schools/search — how a school WITHOUT an official code is chosen (any school of the
list may be chosen this way). It must be an active Rwandan school (400 UNKNOWN_SCHOOL,
409 SCHOOL_INACTIVE); the claim is PENDING exactly as with schoolCode. Not with schoolCode
(400). schoolName and the place fields are ignored when it is sent.

newSchoolCode.description:
A school WITHOUT an official code, chosen by schoolId (owner 2026-11-23): its 6-digit code is required (400
SCHOOL_CODE_REQUIRED) — the first digit is the school's province, and it must not be another school's (409
SCHOOL_CODE_TAKEN). The first valid code becomes the school's code at once (an Administrator corrects it later if
needed). Ignored when the school already has a code.

schoolName.description:
Another country: the school's name as entered (unverified; no school is linked).
